page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 instance type powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Built on KVM hypervisor technology, this server instance provides 128 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) combined with 512 GB of system memory, resulting in a balanced allocation of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

The instance offers a high baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. It features no bundled local ephemeral storage, requiring attached network block storage for operating system installation and data persistence. The high network bandwidth allows for rapid data transfer to external storage volumes and network peripherals, compensating for the absence of local disk drives.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge provides high resource density for enterprise workloads requiring extensive compute capability alongside significant network throughput. The instance is suitable for general-purpose applications, distributed web services, enterprise application servers, mid-tier databases utilizing network storage, and ETL data processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose enterprise instance featuring 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 512 GB of RAM powered by 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processors on a KVM hypervisor. Configured with a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio providing 4 GB of RAM per core, the instance is engineered for balanced compute and memory workloads. The server incorporates a 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, supporting high-throughput connectivity across distributed environments. It does not include local disk storage, necessitating the deployment of external network storage solutions. The substantial compute capacity and high-speed network infrastructure render the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, web servers, data processing tasks, and distributed software architectures that depend on network-attached storage models.
